artifacts.summary: Implementation summary covering literature-audit.sh arg validation and /literature --validate schema scoping, with before/after warning counts.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added usage()/-h|--help/unknown-arg-exit-64/--pdf-operand-guard to literature-audit.sh, and scoped /literature --validate's missing_fields schema check to top-level document entries only (schema-warning population dropped from ~11,093 to 50 on the real index), reconciling Step 2 prose with the actually-enforced 4-field list.

memory_candidates.content: When scoping a per-index-entry validation check to only top-level/document entries (excluding section/chunk children), reuse the existing top-level predicate from the codebase verbatim (here: `.parent_doc == null or .parent_doc == ""` from literature-coverage-delta.sh) rather than inventing a new one (e.g. a path-trailing-slash check) that may serve a different purpose elsewhere. Verify empirically with before/after counts against the real data file, not just a code read -- a predicate that looks right can still leave the wrong population size.

literature-audit.sh and literature-ingest-online.sh in agent-system/extensions/literature/scripts/ share a usage/argument-validation convention: a usage()/show_usage() function that cat's a heredoc to stderr mirroring the script header's documented invocation forms, a `-h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;` arm, and a catch-all `*) echo "<script>: unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage; exit 64 ;;`. New scripts in this extension should follow the same shape rather than silently swallowing unrecognized flags.
